title: トリックしてやるのだ！

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's Halloweeeen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, everyone better watch out! I got tons and tons of tricks in store!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, City! Trick or treat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Get ready, 'cause you're gettin' chomped!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hishiama warned me about this. Let's see here…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you want to chomp on something, chomp on this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a taiyaki! Just the right sweetness, exactly how I like it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If I give you a treat, you can't play a trick on me. Aren't those the rules?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guh?! The only weakness during Halloween—treats! How'd you know?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Everyone knows. Anyway, Happy Halloween, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I screwed up. I didn't know she'd have a treat on her…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But I'm a super genius! I'll just chomp my next target before they get the chance to—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, there ya are, Windy! I got a nice li'l treat, so open wide! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shove!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh?! Munch, munch…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This thick squishiness… Is this taiyaki? And are you trying to choke me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's okay, my treat! Happy Halloween! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is weird… Now I've had two taiyaki in a row!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Graaaah! This time I'll use my quick reflexes to make sure I don't fail!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait, is that who I think it is?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Taiyaki again?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eeek, don't scare me like that! I thought you were going to bite my ear off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrr… Why is everyone giving me taiyaki?! I won't get to play a single trick at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh! This means Hishiama's divination was right on the mark!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Windy is on the prowl. Keep a treat in hand before mischief strikes. That's why she passed out a taiyaki to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I had my doubts… But that taiyaki protected me from harm! Praises be to the great Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So Hishiama thwarted my plans… Grrr, this always happens!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But I did get a lot of attention. And the taiyaki were delicious…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, change of strategy! This time, it's trick or taiyaki! ♪
